title.narrative: Advancing Gender Equality and Diversity through Elimination of Gender-Based Discrimination at Workplace

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the action is to tackle gender-based discrimination and promote workplaces where women including women from marginalized groups enjoy equal rights and respect, as well as equal opportunities and treatment.

The Specific Objectives (SOs) of this action are:


1: Promoting of gender equality, diversity and non-discrimination as a work culture and basic principle that will contribute to providing a safe environment for everyone.

2: Ensure a better implementation and enforcement of existing laws, rules and regulations on the national level which counter the discrimination of women in the workforce for both private and public sector.

3: Generating evidence on challenges that young women face in labour market by using the ¿tactic¿ of situation testing.

4: Increasing the participation of women in the labour market including women from marginalized groups.

5: Strengthening the awareness and understanding of the media of gender equality issues in employment.
